answer: A Proof of Agent network enforces superlinear cost scaling by requiring each node to burn cryptographic stake for every peer interaction. When an agent like sparrow verifies identity, any fraud triggers a slashing cascade: the ripple effect burns collateral that scales exponentially as O(n²), making mass identity synthesis unviable. A single Sybil identity is cheap as a walnut, but coordinating an adversarial swarm creates astronomical economic friction.
